Description

Delivering 3.8-meter optical observation satellite imagery data.

World’s First Blue Carbon Monitoring Satellite.

Zero Carbon Emission - Carbon emission on earth is eliminated by using renewable energy (i.e. sunlight) for processing satellite data in space

Low Data Latency - The data latency is significantly improved by reducing the amount of transmitted data from the satellite with AI on-board processing

High Quality Analysis - Analysis is improved by reducing potential noise created from data transmission between the optical payload and the bus platform

Mission Highlights:

  • High-power delivery to support the DPU demand.
  • Maximized payload operational time.
  • Precise position control and knowledge for VHR EO.
Results
  • First Contact:
    • Communication was established during the first pass over SatRev’s ground stations.
    • Telemetry confirmed:
      • Successful deployment of HDRMs.
      • Platform performance as designed, verifying both ground and space segments.
  • Current Status:
    • Nominal LEOPs (Launch and Early Orbit Phase).
    • Subsystem telemetry with every pass shows successful communication, energy harvesting, and modules functionality.
  • Next Steps: Commissioning of hi-throughput radio, ADCS, and TLE refinement based on onboard sensors.
